FormatUtils.luau.description: Stateless utility for formatting numbers, durations, byte sizes, percentages, and ordinal rank strings. Public entry points include `FormatUtils.formatCompact`, `FormatUtils.formatCommas`, `FormatUtils.formatDuration`, `FormatUtils.formatPercent`, `FormatUtils.formatOrdinal`, `FormatUtils.formatBytes`.
